topic: Temperature Effects on Particle Movement in Matter
key_concepts: Particles move farther and faster when they absorb heat
Heating increases particle motion while cooling decreases it
Ink spreading in water shows particles are in constant motion
Solids have a definite shape and particles that vibrate in place
Liquids take the shape of their container and particles move in limited space
Gases have no fixed shape and particles move freely
Gas particles are far apart and highly compressible
Solid particles are compact with strong cohesion while gas particles have weak cohesion
Diffusion is slow in solids, fast in liquids, and very fast in gases
Melting is a phase change from solid to liquid
Freezing is a phase change from liquid to solid
Sublimation changes solid directly to gas, as with dry ice
